scope: Independent offline XY geometric follower validation; no runtime replacement

follower.projection: Nearest polyline projection; nondecreasing arclength progress
follower.target: Interpolate at progress + lookahead, clamped to path end
follower.speed_policy: Constant 0.2m/s; zero v,w only within 0.01m of path endpoint
follower.angular_policy: w = clip(v * curvature, -0.4, +0.4); no curvature-dependent speed reduction

termination: After each executed interval: geometric overlap or uncertified contact / conservative corridor containment loss / goal entry / time limit
margin_violation: Record but do not stop or override commands
safety_evaluation: Passive post-interval geometry evaluation outside follower; no prospective obstacle check
cross_track_error: Unsigned shortest Euclidean distance to dense XY polyline at every 72Hz pose, including start and final
saturation: Report strict clipping fraction and bound-occupancy fraction separately, per controller update
